title: Connections between the topology of the Morse boundary, the Morse local-to-global property and acylindrical hyperbolicity
summary: We relate the topology of the Morse boundary of a group to geometric and algorithmic properties of the group. In particular, we show that a group has $σ$-compact Morse boundary if and only if it is Morse local-to-global. We also provide tools such as the geodesic Morse local-to-global property to show that groups are (not) Morse local-to-global. Our strategy generalizes tools from small cancellation theory, such as the intersection of relators, to arbitrary finitely generated groups.
